correctness.rationale: For a=0,d,otherwise, Walsh character orthogonality produces the stated 11 spectral rows and positive multiplicities summing N^2. Four nonexceptional rows enforce least ambiguity <=2r for r=min(|U|,|V|,|P|,|Q|), with H=N+2U+(U²+V²+P²+Q²)/2. Minimization in two ranges r<=2 and r>=2 yields kappa>=sqrt(2N)-1 for N>=8, equality only r=sqrt(N/2), U=-r, other three signed r. Solving linear equations yields exactly eight optimizers; direct substitution gives rank and finite condition. Independent exact integer-Gaussian ambiguity enumerations at N=8 and 16 matched all 11 rows and multiplicities in six sample parameter cases. General proof rests on Weyl diagonalization, not finite tests.
residual_risks: No universal optimum among arbitrary Weyl windows, only flat plus two sites; N<8 excluded.
